name: 奥斯瓦尔德·艾弗里
bio_short: 加拿大裔美国细菌学家和研究员。他领导的团队在1944年发表了划时代的论文（`avery_dna_principle_1944`），通过实验证明了DNA（而非蛋白质）是细菌的“转化原则”，从而首次在化学层面上确认了DNA是遗传物质。
bio_short_en: A Canadian-American bacteriologist and researcher. His team published a landmark paper in 1944 (`avery_dna_principle_1944`) demonstrating that DNA (not protein) was the 'transforming principle' in bacteria, providing the first chemical evidence that DNA is the genetic material.
